title: Turn data into a verified report

scenes.title: From an order export to a checked report
scenes.caption: A daily order export becomes a checked JSON report and a written summary. The agent must create and execute the analysis.
scenes.label: THE TASK / SYNTHETIC ORDER RECONCILIATION

steps.title: Order export
steps.detail: Four synthetic orders. Count paid orders, total paid revenue, and count refunds.

steps.title: Agent-written analysis
steps.detail: OpenCode creates analyze.py and runs it with Python inside a disposable sandbox.

steps.title: Checked deliverables
steps.detail: Your worker downloads report.json and summary.md, asserts the totals, then cleans up.

scenes.title: What runs where?
scenes.caption: Your worker coordinates through Harakiri. OpenCode and Python run in the sandbox; model inference is external.
scenes.label: THE EXECUTION BOUNDARY / SDK IS THE COORDINATOR

steps.title: Your Node.js worker
steps.detail: Holds the Harakiri API key. Creates the sandbox, uploads data, tracks the job, verifies files.

steps.title: Harakiri sandbox
steps.detail: Hosts OpenCode and its tools. The agent reads orders.csv, writes code, and executes Python.

steps.title: External free model
steps.detail: OpenCode calls the selected provider. Inference is not local. Only synthetic data is used.

scenes.title: Define success before starting the agent
scenes.caption: Paid revenue: 2500 + 19900 + 7200 = 29600 cents. Exclude the refunded order. Keep the input unchanged.
scenes.label: orders.csv / COMPLETE INPUT

scenes.title: Prepare the Node.js worker
scenes.caption: Install the SDK on your worker. Set the Harakiri API URL and key privately. The sandbox template already contains OpenCode.
scenes.label: YOUR NODE.JS WORKER / SHELL
scenes.content:
npm install @h-sandbox/sdk@0.4.0
export OPENCODE_MODEL=opencode/mimo-v2.5-free
node sdk-report.mjs

scenes.title: Create an isolated OpenCode workspace
scenes.caption: Keep the returned sandbox ID. Wait until running. The 600-second TTL is a fallback; cleanup still runs in finally.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: Transfer the input through the SDK
scenes.caption: Upload data, not a prewritten analysis. /workspace is the remote sandbox directory. Retain the local input for verification.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: Make the free-model choice explicit
scenes.caption: Pin both main and small models to the free model. Broad tool permissions apply only to this synthetic, disposable demo.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: Give the agent the complete task
scenes.caption: The complete prompt specifies input, program, output schema, execution and an unchanged CSV. No hidden instructions.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT
scenes.content:
const prompt = [
  'Read orders.csv.',
  'Write analyze.py using only the Python standard library.',
  'It must sum total_cents only for paid rows and count refunded rows.',
  'Execute it to create report.json with exactly paid_orders,',
  'revenue_cents, refunded_orders integer fields,',
  'and summary.md with a short business summary.',
  'Do not modify orders.csv.',
  'Use your tools to write and execute the program, not just describe it.',
].join(' ');

scenes.title: agentCommand is an ordinary shell string
scenes.caption: run: non-interactive task. --format json: execution events. --model: explicit model. shellQuote keeps the prompt one argument.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: Start a tracked background command
scenes.caption: agentCommand runs in /workspace. detached returns a job ID. timeoutMs limits command execution to four minutes.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: Wait for completion and inspect the logs
scenes.caption: 260 seconds is the caller waiting budget, not a longer execution limit. Read logs before cleanup. Exit 0 alone is not acceptance.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: Inspect real work, not an agent promise
scenes.caption: These are completed tools from the real run. The script checks zero reported model cost; private reasoning is not published.
scenes.label: RECORDED COMPLETED TOOLS / COMMAND EXCERPTS
scenes.content:
read     /workspace/orders.csv
write    /workspace/analyze.py
bash     python analyze.py
bash     python3 analyze.py
read     /workspace/report.json
read     /workspace/summary.md

scenes.title: Retrieve files before destroying the runtime
scenes.caption: Download JSON, summary and original input before termination. contentBase64 is the file envelope, not the agent answer.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: Make your application the final judge
scenes.caption: Assert exact totals and unchanged input before saving. The summary must be nonempty; its prose needs separate review.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT

scenes.title: The verified result is now in your worker
scenes.caption: Verified JSON and summary are saved in your worker. This recording passed; future agent runs must pass the same checks.
scenes.label: report.json / DOWNLOADED AND INDEPENDENTLY ASSERTED

scenes.title: Always clean up, including on failure
scenes.caption: finally handles success and failure. Verify terminated. If connectivity prevents cleanup, recover using the sandbox ID and TTL.
scenes.label: sdk-report.mjs / SOURCE EXCERPT
